note: The owner gate is acceptance of a finished, evidenced result. It is not permission to begin. Owner is a seat, not a person: owner(X) is the seat one edge up, the seat that issued X's grant and settles X's receipts (decisions/0020). Acceptance therefore happens at whatever height the work actually reached, not at the root by default. This file states machine-checkably which work needs no owner act at all, which transitions may still wait and for exactly which reason, and what a presented result must contain. It grants no authority: an owner action is still taken by the seat that holds it.

conditions: the change is reversible by a record-local counter-record or a git revert
the change stays inside an already declared boundary or declares a new one as a proposal
the actor records what it chose and what would defeat the choice
presumptive_execution.note: Work meeting these conditions needs no prior owner act. An agent that stops to ask for one is refused by PREAPPROVAL_REQUESTED and told to build the result and present it.

hold_reasons.EXTERNAL_WORLD_EFFECT: The transition commits an effect outside this node that no local counter-record reverses.
hold_reasons.IRREVERSIBLE: The transition cannot be counteracted, only compensated forward.
hold_reasons.PUBLICATION: The transition makes repository content public.
hold_reasons.OWNER_IDENTITY_OR_NAMING: The transition changes the product name, repository name, or an owner identity.
hold_reasons.SECRET_EXPOSURE: The transition places, moves, or uses a live credential.
hold_reasons.DESTRUCTIVE_ADMIN: The transition rewrites published history or deletes a shared ref or repository.
hold_reasons.RESOURCE_COMMITMENT: The transition spends money or a metered external quota.

hold_reasons_note: This list is exhaustive. A transition may wait on the owner only for a reason named here. Wanting the owner's opinion is not a reason; it is an acceptance item, and the work is finished first.
packet_note: A presented result must let the owner decide from the output. visible_result names a command the owner can run; evidence names exact addresses and digests; what_could_defeat_it names the strongest known failure. A packet that hides a residual to look finished is a defect against this contract, not a presentation choice.

owner_actions.ACCEPT: The presented result stands. Its standing advances as on_accept states.
owner_actions.REJECT: The presented result does not stand. It returns to its builder with the reason recorded.
owner_actions.STRIKE: The result stands but the claim is withdrawn from the record entirely.
owner_actions.REDIRECT: The result stands as evidence but the work turns to a named different objective.

refusal_codes.ACCEPTANCE_BY_NON_OWNER: The accepting seat is not owner_seat of the presenting seat. Ownership is one edge up and does not chain.
refusal_codes.HOLD_WITHOUT_ADMISSIBLE_REASON: A hold on the owner names no reason from hold_reasons.
refusal_codes.HOLD_WITHOUT_NAMED_TRANSITION: A hold does not name exactly one transition it stops.
refusal_codes.HOLD_WITHOUT_REACHABLE_ALTERNATIVE: A hold does not record what stays reachable while it stands.
refusal_codes.PACKET_INCOMPLETE: A presented result is missing a section required by packet_required_sections.
refusal_codes.PACKET_WITHOUT_DEFEATER: A presented result names no condition that would defeat it.
refusal_codes.PREAPPROVAL_REQUESTED: Permission was requested to perform reversible record-local work. Build it and present the result.
refusal_codes.RULING_WITHOUT_COUNTER: A standing default records no condition that would overturn it, so it is a decree rather than a default.
refusal_codes.SELF_ACCEPTANCE_REFUSED: The accepting seat is the presenting seat. No seat settles its own output (CONTRACT.md C7, generalised to every tier by decisions/0020).
refusal_codes.UNDRAINED_QUESTION: A question sits in the owner queue that is neither a recorded ruling, a presented acceptance item, nor an admissible hold.
refusal_codes.ACCEPTANCE_SEAT_CANNOT_SETTLE: The accepting seat's settles list does not contain the claim's type.
refusal_codes.SELF_DIRECTION_PRESENTED: A seat presented its own bounded execution choice for acceptance. It decides that itself.
refusal_codes.UNOCCUPIED_SEAT: The accepting seat has no recorded occupant, so no actor can take the action.

ledger_note: Owner actions append to a local ledger. The ledger is a record of what the owner did; the standing change it authorises still lands in the owning governing document by an ordinary edit.
acceptance_rule: A result presented by seat X is accepted by owner_seat(X) and by no other seat. Ownership is one edge up and does not chain: the root seat accepts what the control seat presents, and never reaches past it to accept a worker's report. A work seat settles nothing above its own execution and presents nothing to itself.

settles_required.JUDGEMENT: A claim about product intent, naming, a boundary, or a phase gate. Only a seat whose settles list contains JUDGEMENT may accept it.
settles_required.VERIFICATION: A claim that a declared check held. Any owning seat whose settles list contains VERIFICATION may accept it.

self_direction: A seat decides its own work: what to inspect, which legal operation to attempt, how to sequence reversible changes, when to abandon a failed line. That decision needs no packet and no owner act, and a seat that presents one for acceptance is refused by SELF_DIRECTION_PRESENTED. Only a claim that binds a seat other than the presenter travels upward.
